items.heading: Check the Fit
items.text: Check the fit. Ask whether the answer fits your audience, context, and constraints or whether it is just broadly plausible.

items.heading: Check the Blind Spots
items.text: Check the blind spots. Ask what might be missing, risky, or oversimplified.

items.heading: Check the Tone and Trust
items.text: Check the tone and trust level. If the output sounds robotic, overconfident, or emotionally tone-deaf, fix it before using it.
